bits_nonzero.meaning: control predicate is true if any of the 32 bits are set

bits_zero.meaning: control predicate is true if all 32 bits are clear

convert_i32_to_f32.meaning: signed int32 numerical conversion to float32, not bit reinterpretation; D3D rounding allowance retained

convert_u32_to_f32.meaning: unsigned uint32 numerical conversion to float32, not bit reinterpretation; round to nearest even when the integer is not exactly representable

copy_bits32.meaning: unmodified move copies bits exactly; source modifier and saturation are represented separately

divide_f32.meaning: D3D division; permitted direct quotient or multiplication by reciprocal is not selected here

dot2_f32.meaning: D3D 2-component dot product of swizzled components; scalar result replicated; operation retained rather than expanded with a chosen rounding order

dot3_f32.meaning: D3D 3-component dot product of swizzled components; scalar result replicated; operation retained rather than expanded with a chosen rounding order

dot4_f32.meaning: D3D 4-component dot product of swizzled components; scalar result replicated; operation retained rather than expanded with a chosen rounding order

exp2_f32.meaning: base-two exponential; preserve D3D precision and exceptional-value behavior

floor_f32.meaning: round float component to integral float toward negative infinity; distinct from integer conversion

greater_equal_f32_mask.meaning: ordered float comparison: true→0xffffffff, false→0; any NaN operand gives false

less_than_f32_mask.meaning: ordered float comparison: true→0xffffffff, false→0; any NaN operand gives false

log2_f32.meaning: base-two logarithm; preserve D3D precision and exceptional-value behavior

maximum_d3d_f32.meaning: component maximum; if exactly one operand is NaN returns the other; denorm comparison follows D3D

minimum_d3d_f32.meaning: component minimum; if exactly one operand is NaN returns the other; denorm comparison follows D3D

multiply_add_f32.meaning: D3D multiply-add operation; hardware fusion and intermediate rounding are not fixed by this model

negative_absolute_f32.meaning: absolute-value modifier followed by float sign negation

not_equal_f32_mask.meaning: float inequality: true→0xffffffff, false→0; any NaN operand gives true

saturate_d3d_f32.meaning: destination saturation after source arithmetic; min(1,max(0,result)) with D3D NaN-to-zero behavior

select_bits_nonzero.meaning: select argument1 when any bits in argument0 are set, otherwise argument2; componentwise

scope.coverage: all stage records and every executable instruction for the selected package groups; includes all serialized keys in these groups

state_model.comparison_masks: comparison true is 0xffffffff, false is 0x00000000; masks are not float values or integer 1
state_model.copy_bits32: exact bit copy in the absence of source modifiers and saturation; arithmetic operands interpret bits according to their operator
state_model.dot_product: dotN_f32 computes one scalar from the first N swizzled source components, then replicates it to each written component
state_model.floating_execution: preserve separate source operations and destination saturation; multiply_add_f32 stays one D3D mad operation; does not prescribe a CPU library or assume exact GPU fusion/rounding
state_model.initialization: temporary and output components begin undefined; no zero initialization is assumed
state_model.input_components: vN.c and cbN[index].c name actual declared shader slots; resource samples are tN plus sN
state_model.integer_modifiers: negation on an integer operand is two-complement negation modulo 2^32
state_model.literal_bits32: authoritative exact 32-bit constant representation; decimal and signed-integer views are explanatory
state_model.ordered_execution: evaluate tree in order; only selected if body executes; loop has local break; return exits entire program
state_model.read_before_write: all equations in one simultaneous_assignment read the state before any component in that assignment is written
state_model.sample_component_selection: sample component refers to the original sampled vector channel after resource swizzle; written destination position determines swizzle position
state_model.sampling_execution: implicit derivative samples preserve control placement; sampler/address/filter state and SRV formats remain unproven
state_model.source_float_modifiers: float negate/absolute operate on the component before the arithmetic expression
state_model.state_components: qN.xyzw are mutable 32-bit temporary components; oN.xyzw are mutable output components

unclosed_edges: CPU writers for every referenced constant component, including image-space slot cb2 and frame slot cb12
